newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed, outlook optimistic.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed, outlook optimistic.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mixed on Thursday with blue chips continuing to rise and traders were optimistic share prices would grow further in line with world trends.
"It is wonderful. This is the second big upswing since the beginning of September," Velimir Zelimorski of Fima brokerage said, predicting a strong expansion thanks to foreign buyers.
"Zagrebacka Banka (lately) registered a fantastic growth and now brokers are on a hunt for the next stock to be listed on the London market," he said.
* Of ten active issues five were up, two fell and three stayed unchanged.
* The most active Zagrebacka Banka gained 53 kuna to 900 with 4,910 shares sold.
* Drugs firm Pliva jumped 500 kuna to 13,000 on volume of 127 units.
* Hotelier Laguna added 15 kuna to 870 selling 60 units.
* Cable maker Elka rose 13 kuna to 160 with 1,358 shares sold.
* Food-processor Podravka regained five kuna, lost on Wednesday, to close at 230 kuna on volume of 1,329 shares.
* Confectioner Kras was unchanged at 430 kuna after peaking at 500 during the session. It sold 1,097 shares.
* Hoteliers Riviera Porec and Arenaturist also flat at 105 and 100 kuna receptively with 745 and 92 shares sold.
* Another two hotel firms were the only losers:
- Jadranturist fell 30 kuna to 170, selling 969 shares.
- Suncani Hvar down five kuna to 40 on volume of 2,011.
* Volume slightly lower at 12,968 shares, turnover also down at 7.4 million kuna.
